Ugmuls 5.5e Automation · v0.8.2

More of your character.
Less to keep track of.

Spend Sneak Attack dice on a Cunning Strike. Deflect a hit. Choose your Ranger’s next move. 0.8.2 connects more Rogue, Fighter, Barbarian, Monk and Ranger features to the rolls and cards you already use.

Damage riders, reactions, repeat saves and linked auras handle the routine follow-through. Players keep the choices—and now get a Roll prompt for supported automatic healing, too.

Explore the full class guide →

Rogue & Monk

Make the strike.
Choose what follows.

  • Rogue choices, built into damage. Cunning Strike, Improved Cunning Strike and Devious Strikes share the Sneak Attack workflow, with supported saves and effect cleanup. Assassin, Soulknife, Thief and Scion features get their own follow-through.
  • Monk turns that keep moving. Flurry counters offer two attacks—or three with Heightened Focus—with Open Hand techniques, Mercy healing and harm, and Elemental options where they belong.
  • React from the card. Uncanny Dodge, Evasion and Deflect Attacks help resolve incoming damage while keeping the original dice and correction controls connected.

Monk controls and subclass details →

Fighter & Barbarian

Meet the moment.
Spend the resource.

  • Fighter decisions after the hit. Psionic Strike can wait until weapon damage is applied. Protective Field reduces an ally’s incoming damage, while Indomitable and Studied Attacks keep their rerolls and target tracking connected.
  • More subclass support. Champion healing, Arcane Archer effect follow-through and Banneret ally selection join the existing Battle Master tools.
  • Rage brings its benefits. Linked Primal Knowledge and Mindless Rage, Relentless Rage saves, Wild Heart selections and auras, and World Tree temporary HP reduce extra card work.

Fighter details →

Barbarian details →

Ranger

Track the prey.
Keep the hunt moving.

  • The Mark stays connected. Relentless Hunter, Precise Hunter and Foe Slayer build on Hunter’s Mark. Hunter choices move into rest dialogs, and supported companion damage follows the owning Ranger’s mark.
  • A place for each path. Gloom Stalker and Fey Wanderer gain their damage choices and follow-ups. Hollow Warden links its transformation, fear aura, healing and weapon riders.
  • Winter comes with you. Winter Walker gains Polar Strikes, Cold-resistance bypass, Hunter’s Rime temporary HP, fear-save protection, Chilling Retribution and a token-following Frozen Haunt aura.

Browse Ranger subclass details →

Player-controlled healing

The healing is ready.
You roll the dice.

Supported automated healing and temporary HP now create a pending roll and prompt the source character’s active owner, with GM fallback. Hunter’s Rime, Hungering Might, Survivor and recurring healing use this flow.

Prefer an immediate roll? Enable Automations → Common → Skip Automatic Healing Roll Prompts. Whether HP is applied automatically remains a separate setting.

Healing prompts and application settings →

Flow & control

Keep the routine moving.
Keep the decisions.

This release also fixes hidden damage-configuration choices with AC5e, double-counted cover AC, missing Smite repeat-save sources, Studied Attacks feedback loops, and early display of player reaction results before dice animations finish.

Automatic damage and effects remain optional. Forced movement, companion commands, shared-damage decisions and documented situational abilities remain table-managed. Features can be enabled separately.

Refresh GM and player clients after updating. Matching official content is required for the features you use. For auras, use Grid Shaped emanations and match the scene grid to the map; recorded testing uses alternating 1–2–1 diagonals. Avoid duplicate automation for the same feature from overlapping modules.

Foundry VTT 14 · D&D5e 6.0.5 minimum; recorded testing on 6.0.6.
